title: Maybe Slowly, Maybe Imperfectly
script_text:
I'm proud of you, for not giving up on yourself.
Even when you were disappointed.
Even when you felt behind.
Even when you looked around and thought everyone else was doing better.
You kept going.
Maybe slowly, maybe imperfectly.
But you kept going.
And I'll always admire you for that.

title: We'll Both Have Bad Days
script_text:
I love you, but I know we'll both have bad days.
Days when you're irritated.
Days when I'm tired.
Days when we take things personally that weren't meant that way.
But even then, one bad day won't change what you mean to me.
Through every hard day we go through, you'll have me and I'll have you.

title: I Don't Want To Keep Score
script_text:
I love you, and I don't want us to keep score.
Who was irritated first, who did more, who was right, who made the last mistake.
I don't want to win against you.
I want us to get through things together.
Because no matter what we're going through, it will always be us, me and you.

title: So Much Further Than Where You Started
script_text:
I'm proud of you.
Because I remember when this used to feel impossible.
When you doubted yourself.
When you didn't know if you could do it.
And now look at you.
Maybe you're still not where you want to be.
But you're so much further than where you started.
Every step brought you here.
And I'm so proud of you.

title: Why I Do Too
script_text:
I love seeing you being loved by your family, your friends, the people who knew you before I did.
Watching them laugh with you, tell stories about you, and care about you.
And seeing how much you mean to them, makes me understand a little more, why I do too.

title: Honesty Is Part Of Loving You
script_text:
Loving you doesn't always mean I'll agree with you.
Sometimes I'll be real with you.
I'll tell you what you don't want to hear.
Not to hurt you, not to prove you wrong.
But because I care about you.
And honesty is part of loving you.

title: Proud Of The Things Nobody Claps For
script_text:
I'm proud of you.
And not only when you succeed.
I'm proud of the things nobody claps for.
The days you kept going.
The things you carried quietly.
The times you almost gave up.
You may not always see how far you've come.
But I do.
I always believe in you.

title: Where My Heart Wants To Be
script_text:
I love you.
And I know sometimes your mind will tell you I'm leaving.
That I'm getting tired, that I'll find someone else, that one bad day will be enough.
Whenever your mind starts telling you that, tell me.
I'll hold you close and remind you that I'm still here.
Right where my heart wants to be.

title: You Make Me Smile
script_text:
You make me smile, especially when you don't even know I'm looking.
When you're focused on something, singing badly, talking to yourself.
Doing whatever weird thing you do when you're comfortable.
Those are the moments I like most.
Because you have no idea how much I love that side of you.

title: You Know You Got Me
script_text:
Sometimes I'm annoyed, and I really want to stay annoyed.
Then you say something stupid.
I try not to laugh.
You notice.
And now you're smiling because you know you got me.
So I'm trying even harder not to smile.
I hate when you do that.
But I love that you know just how to.

title: More Than My Pride
script_text:
I love you.
But I know I won't always get it right.
There will be times I misunderstand you.
Times I say the wrong thing.
Maybe even times I hurt you without meaning to.
But when I do, I'll make it right.
And I'll make sure you still feel loved.
Because you matter more than my pride.

title: 'I' Became 'We'
script_text:
I don't know when it happened, but somehow I became we.
Where should we go?
What should we eat?
What are we doing this weekend?
It happened naturally.
I never really thought of it.
Until I realized, you're not just part of my plans.
You're part of my future.

title: Worth Remembering
script_text:
Before you, a coffee was just a coffee.
A song was just a song.
A walk was just a walk.
But with you, doing those same little things started to feel special.
You didn't make my life perfect.
You just made ordinary things worth remembering.

title: Sometimes We Argue
script_text:
Sometimes we argue.
And for a few minutes, you annoy me more than anyone in the world.
But even then, you're still the person I want to tell everything to.
Still the person I want right beside me.
I think that's the strange thing about really loving someone.
Being mad at you never makes me stop wanting you.

title: I'll Keep Choosing You
script_text:
I fell in love with you, and someday, parts of the person I love today may change.
But it doesn't scare me, because I never needed you to stay the same.
Grow, change, become.
Even if loving you means learning you again, I'll keep choosing you through all of it.

title: I Doubt Everything But You
script_text:
Shakespeare said, doubt the stars, doubt the sun, doubt everything, but never doubt my love for you.
I have doubted myself a thousand times.
My choices, my future, the person I'm becoming.
But the one thing I am always sure of, you.

title: The Reality Of Time
script_text:
The painful reality of time is that it only moves in one direction.
We spend our youth rushing to grow up, and the rest of our lives wishing we could go back.
We trade our youth for wisdom.
Right as the story comes to an end.
That's what makes growing older so beautiful, yet so sad.

title: Actions Speak Louder Than Words
script_text:
Talk is cheap, and empty promises are hard to keep.
But a genuine effort will always be a genuine effort.
Words are just a disguise.
Actions are where the truth lies.
Because it's easy to talk the talk.
But it takes effort to walk the walk.

title: For The Love We Lost, But Will Forever Carry
script_text:
I miss you.
I miss your smile.
I miss your touch.
I miss everything about you.
I was hoping to spend my forever with you.
But God had different plans.
I thank Him for taking all your pain.
And I hope one day, when my journey is done, our souls will meet again.
My only one.

title: Words Left Unspoken
script_text:
One of the burdens we carry are the words left unspoken.
We stay quiet to keep the peace.
And end up drowning in our own thoughts.
We swallow our feelings.
And just quietly fall apart.
That's what makes silence so incredibly loud.

title: Forgive Yourself
script_text:
The truth is, you need to forgive yourself.
You keep replaying what you did wrong.
But forget all the things you did right.
You can't change the past.
But you can change how you move forward.
Your mistakes do not define you.
Forgive yourself.
Find your peace.

title: Quiet Beginnings
script_text:
The love you lose teaches worth.
The lie you hear teaches truth.
The noise you ignore teaches peace.
The mistake you make teaches growth.
The pain you feel teaches strength.
What feels like an ending is just a quiet beginning.

title: Thankful That You Are Here
script_text:
Dear love, you matter to me more than you know.
Maybe I don't say it often.
Maybe I hide it behind jokes.
But I appreciate you.
I remember you.
I carry little pieces of our conversations throughout my day.
I am so thankful that you are here.

title: Imperfectly Perfect
script_text:
I love you unconditionally.
Your clumsiness, your silliness, your messiness, and all your imperfections.
I want the real you.
No pretending, no hiding who you really are, just the real you.
Because for me, you are imperfectly perfect.

title: My Favorite Story
script_text:
My life had so many blank pages, so many empty chapters waiting to be written.
And then you became my favorite story.
To be the one who shares your morning coffee.
The one who laughs at your silly jokes.
And the one who gets to grow old with you.
I am so deeply thankful for this life.
For every chapter we have written.
And every page we still get to write together.

title: You Are My Everything
script_text:
You are my everything, my best friend, my safe space, my favorite person.
I love how you understand me, my quietest thoughts, my loudest dreams, my silliest fears.
Even when I make absolutely no sense, even when I can't find the right words.
You always know exactly what my heart needs.
That is why I will love you, and you will always be my everything.

title: Timeless
script_text:
One day your face will change.
Your hair will turn grey.
And time will leave its mark on both of us.
But I will love the lines on your skin.
And I will cherish every single story they tell.
I will look into your eyes.
And still see the person I first fell in love with.
Because time can change how we look.
But my love for you never will.

title: Lose Yourself, Or Be Found?
script_text:
Some say to truly love someone is to slowly lose yourself.
Others say to truly love someone is to finally find who you are.
So the question is, when you fall in love, do you want to lose yourself?
Or do you want to be found?

title: I'm Keeping You Forever
script_text:
I love the way you love.
I love your gentle soul.
I love the way you make the hardest days feel absolutely effortless.
Even when we are exhausted.
Even when we are overwhelmed.
Even when we are just sitting in complete silence.
I look at you, and I know.
I found exactly what my heart was looking for.
I'm keeping you forever.

title: I Am So Proud Of You
script_text:
I believe in you.
I believe in your dreams.
I believe in the incredible things you are going to achieve.
When you doubt yourself, I will remind you of your worth.
When you stumble, I will be the one to catch you.
And when you succeed, I will be the one cheering the loudest.
Don't ever let the world make you feel small.
Because I have seen what you are capable of.
And I am so proud of you.

title: It Will Always Be You
script_text:
It is you.
It has always been you.
It will always be you.
Without conditions.
Without hesitation.
Without questions.
I will love you through the quiet days.
Through the loud nights.
Through every season we have yet to face.
And no matter what changes, my answer is always you.

title: I Love You Forever
script_text:
I love you as you are, as you were, and as you will be.
Even on our hardest days.
Even when everything feels too heavy.
Even when the years start to catch up with us, and the quiet days blur together.
Through every chapter, I will love you as long as I breathe.

title: The Hand That Never Lets Go
script_text:
Dear love, I know you're used to people who walk away when things get hard.
But I will be the one who stays.
I'll become the quiet reminder that you are deeply wanted, exactly as you are today.
I'll become the hand that never lets go of yours.
Not just for a season, but for a lifetime.
And this is my promise to you.

title: Destined
script_text:
There is a Japanese legend that says two souls are tied together.
Not by luck, not by timing, not by coincidence, but by an invisible red thread that fate refuses to break.
They'll be tested by distance, by silence, by time.
But when fate finally pulls them close, they won't feel like strangers.
They'll arrive like peace, like a heartbeat their souls already knew.

title: Let Them Be Wrong
script_text:
Let them make you the villain.
Let them tell it their way.
Let them turn your boundary into betrayal.
You know what happened.
You know what you carried.
The people who truly wanted the truth would have asked, not accused.
So stop chasing a fair version of the story.
Keep your peace.
Live your truth.
Let them be wrong.

title: Love Who Stays
script_text:
There is a Japanese legend that says the moon pulls the ocean, and the waves always return.
I kept calling your return love.
Because admitting you never stayed hurt more.
But some waves come back only to leave the shore again.
And I finally learned love is not who returns.
Love is who stays.

title: Given Unsought Is Better
script_text:
Shakespeare said, love sought is good, but given unsought is better.
I never understood what that meant until you.
I spent my whole life chasing people, begging to be chosen, exhausting myself just to prove I was worth keeping around.
But you didn't wait for me to ask.
You didn't make me earn my place.
You just showed up.
And handed me the kind of love I never thought I'd experience.

title: Thank You For Loving Me
script_text:
Thank you for loving me when I didn't know how to be loved.
For loving the deep scars I spent years trying to bury.
For choosing patience when all I gave you was silence.
You didn't erase my pain.
You made it feel safe to carry.
And if life rewrote itself a million times, I would choose you every single time.

title: Immune To You
script_text:
The terrifying part is, I am no longer immune to you.
I used to be fine on my own.
I was good at keeping people at a distance.
But one message from you can change my whole mood.
Your voice softens my guard.
Your laugh gets through me when nothing else can.
And the way you look at me makes everything else feel far away.
I don't want attention.
I want you.
That's what scares me.
You became the habit my heart doesn't want to break.

title: The Part Where I Leave
script_text:
I am no longer writing explanations on pages you choose to skip.
I am not highlighting my heart just to make it visible to you.
You are free to misread my chapters until whatever version of my story makes you feel at home.
I am not rewriting my truth just to fit your narrow margins.
My silence is not an invitation to fix it.
It is the part where I leave.

title: You Just Needed To Be Met
script_text:
You spend years believing you are too difficult to hold.
So you hide your chaos.
You learn to carry your storms alone.
Until the day a gentle soul sees the parts of you, you were afraid would make them leave.
And instead of stepping back, they move closer.
And suddenly you realize you never needed to be fixed.
You just needed to be met.

title: Do Not Mistake My Silence
script_text:
Do not mistake my silence for weakness.
I have nothing left to prove.
I am no longer convincing anyone of my value.
And I am done fighting to be understood by people who are committed to misunderstanding me.
Whatever you do from here is on you.
Just understand.
Once I turn down the volume of my presence, you lose the right to hear from me again.

title: Quiet Devotion
script_text:
Do you know why true devotion is quiet?
Because it is heavy.
It is forged by silent rooms, by unspoken fears, by the coldness of the world.
It forces you to face the dark, without ever letting go of the light.
But if two hearts still choose the anchor over the drift, that is not just a feeling.
That is a sanctuary.

title: The Right Stranger
script_text:
We are taught to build walls to protect who we are.
We learn to hide our flaws so we can be chosen.
We guard our secrets so we can never be ruined.
We spend our whole lives trying to stay completely whole, all on our own.
But then you meet someone, and suddenly, you don't mind becoming a little bit undone.

title: Safe With You
script_text:
I know I am not always easy to love.
My mind gets loud.
My walls go up.
Some days, I carry a silence I do not know how to explain.
But you never ask me to become easier.
You just stay gentle.
You hold my hand when it shakes.
You love me, even on the days I forget how to love myself.
And that is how I know you are not just someone I love.
You are the place my heart feels safe.

title: The Kind Of Love That Lasts
script_text:
The kind of love that lasts is not built on perfect moments.
It is built on patience, on forgiveness, on choosing gentleness when being right would be easier.
On holding hands through ordinary days and heavy seasons.
Because forever is never made from one beautiful promise.
It is made from two people choosing each other in the quietest ways.
Again and again.

title: You Are My Always
script_text:
If I had to meet you all over again, in another time, in another place, with another version of my life, I think my heart would still find you.
Maybe not in the same way, maybe not on the same day, but somehow, I believe I would still know you.
Not because love is perfect.
But because some people feel too rare to be chosen just once.

title: You Are My Peace
script_text:
I cannot promise that every day will be perfect.
But I can promise you will not be loved halfway.
I will choose you in the quiet mornings, in the tired evenings, and in the ordinary moments no one else sees.
Because love is not only something I feel.
It is something I keep choosing.
